links.outcome: LLM performance on script concordance test clinical reasoning versus typical medical multiple-choice benchmark performance
links.effect: LLMs scored markedly lower on SCTs than on MCQ benchmarks; GPT-4o 63.6%, Claude-3.5 Sonnet 58.8%, o1-preview 58.5%, Gemini-1.5-Pro 54.4%; below senior residents and attendings.
links.quote: LLMs demonstrated markedly lower performance on SCTs compared to their typical achievement on medical multiple choice benchmarks.

unlisted_practices: Using Script Concordance Testing as a benchmark of LLM clinical reasoning under uncertainty

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating clinical reasoning in state-of-the-art LLMs on a 750-question Script Concordance Test (SCT) dataset.
